name: leon
title: Leon
description: See what your Superset agents need, keep the Mac awake, and clean up worktrees through the Leon avatar app.
author: maoryosef

commands.name: tasks
commands.title: Leon Tasks
commands.description: Agents that need you, failed, finished, or are working, plus Leon's settings.

commands.name: workspaces
commands.title: Open Superset Workspace
commands.description: Jump to any open Superset workspace, most recent first.

commands.name: cleanup
commands.title: Clean Up Workspaces
commands.description: Exit agents and delete Superset worktrees in a batch.

commands.name: toggle-keep-awake
commands.title: Toggle Keep Mac Awake
commands.description: Turn Leon's keep-awake mode on or off.

commands.name: toggle-lid-awake
commands.title: Toggle Stay Awake With Lid Closed
commands.description: Turn all sleep on or off, lid close included. Asks for your password.
